sources.notes: Axes must be alphabetically ordered; tuples must be numerically ordered. Availability of families/axes/values requires Google-side validation.

assumptions: The family and requested axis/value combinations actually exist in Google Fonts.
licensing_data_restrictions: No user content is transmitted by normal tool execution. Third-party libraries retain their upstream licenses; font/PDF licensing remains the user’s responsibility.
uncertainty: This builder does not call Google to validate availability. Google may reject unsupported families, axes, values, overlapping tuples or malformed combinations.
